hero.bio1: I have been teaching mathematics for more than fifteen years, and I am convinced that memorising formulas means nothing if a student cannot see the logic behind them. My lessons are built on clear explanations, visual examples and a great deal of independent practice.
hero.bio2: I prepare students for national exams, olympiads and international competitions — both one to one and in small groups.
hero.statusNote: Autumn groups — online and on site

testimonials.title: Success stories
testimonials.description: My work is described best by what my students achieve — from university admission to olympiad medals.

items.name: Nino Kvaratskhelia
items.quote: I was always afraid of mathematics until I started studying with Shota. Within a year I learned to see the structure of a problem and scored full marks in the exam.

items.name: Luka Maisuradze
items.quote: We worked through olympiad problems every week. What helped most was that he never handed me a ready answer — he made me think and led me to the solution myself.

items.name: Ana Tskitishvili
items.quote: Geometry became completely clear after the visual models and interactive graphs. Today I help my own classmates with the difficult topics.
